text:
nina.dev: Pushed release 2026.3.1 to prod-n. Kicking off a targeted prefill/probe wave for 10m (timebox). @deploy-bot start synthetic suite x10 sampling and post summaries here. runbook -> https://redwood.local/runbooks/prefill-probes :spiral_calendar:
deploy-bot: Deploy acknowledged: release=2026.3.1, cohort=prod-n, nodes=72, rollout=12%. Synthetic sampling set to 10x. Report channel -> #deploy-summaries.
raj.sre: Running quick checks: /health and 30 short chatgen prompts + embed tiny vector probes. curl health:
```
curl -s https://prod-n.api.redwood/v1/health | jq '.'
{\n  "ok": true,\n  "nodes": 72,\n  "active_shards": 24
}
```
raj.sre: First 5m metrics: chatgen p95=220ms (baseline 200), kv p95=130ms (baseline 120) — minor jitter. Embed route us-east-2 showing increase in 502s: 3.9% over last 3m (baseline ~0.1%). Queues on embed-worker-4 rising.
qa-evan: I replayed a small user flow and saw a handful of 502 responses with body: "upstream error: model-unavailable". Trace IDs -> rp:8f3a.., rp:8f3b..
lisa.pm: Any customer impact? Should we throttle ramp or rollback the model variant?
raj.sre: No broad customer reports yet. Propose: 1) divert 15% of embed traffic to fallback variant v2026.2.9 2) scale embed-worker replica count + restart embed-worker-4 3) reduce batch size from 64 -> 48 for embed path. If metrics improve, continue hold and monitor 20m.
ops-oncall: Performing restart of embed-worker-4 now, increasing replica set from 6 -> 9. Applying temporary route: embed.variant weight: default->85%, v2026.2.9->15%.
deploy-bot: Traffic split applied: embed.variant=v2026.2.9 weight=15% for cohort=prod-n. Change logged -> https://deploy.logs/3249994321/split.
ops-oncall: Restart complete. Pod warmup traces look clean, no crashloops.
raj.sre: Re-run probe at T+7m: embed 502s down to 0.6%, p95 embed=260ms (baseline 230). chatgen and kv stable.
nina.dev: Decision: freeze ramp at 12%, increase probe frequency to every 90s for next 20m. No full rollback unless embed 5xx+502s > 4% sustained for 10m OR p95 embed > 480ms for 5m. Notify support if customer reports come in. @qa-evan keep replaying flows.
qa-evan: Will run targeted replay every 2m and post anomalies.
r aj.sre: (typo) raj.sre: Final check-in T+20m: embed 502s average 0.4%, p95=240ms. Stabilized. Recommend gradual ramp to 35% over next 30m with close monitoring.
lisa.pm: Sounds good. I'll update release notes with hold + mitigation steps.
ops-oncall: Opening a short-lived incident log for post-deploy actions and mitigation steps for runbook. Closing if no regression in next 30m.
deploy-bot: Ramp hold lifted to allow controlled increase to 35% as approved. Will post next metrics at T+10m.
